dialogues.speaker: Tlapo
dialogues.text: (The enormous Iktomisaurus stands majestically, sometimes glancing over at the flickering flames.)

dialogues.speaker: Tlapo
dialogues.text: You are something special, I see. No ordinary Saurian, sure, but... You lack any malicious aura or evil intent about you.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapo
dialogues.text: I will allow you passage through my turf. But please be careful with the wings and eyes of the Saurian whelps.
